blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Jones Llabares Inso settled for sixth place in the men’s taijiquan and taijijian final, as the medal remained elusive for the Philippine wushu team in the Asian Games. Inso garnered a total score of 19.403 in two events, as China’s Dewen Liu got the gold as the runaway winner with 19.560 points. Taipei’s Chia-hung Sun earned the silver with 19.453 points, while South Korea’s An Hyeon-gi was the bronze medalist with 19.429 points.
